name: Jenni AI
tagline: Jenni AI is an AI writing assistant designed for academic writing. It helps researchers draft papers, write literature reviews, cite sources in APA/MLA/Chicago formats, and paraphrase existing text. Its in-text citation feature directly inserts references from a growing database of academic sources, reducing the risk of plagiarism.
